name: Disneyland Plaza Inn Penne Pasta with Plain Butter, Olive Oil & Parmesan (No Marinara Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Plaza Inn (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Refined semolina penne pasta served plain or with a touch of butter/olive oil and aged Parmesan cheese gives you a completely tomato-free, spice-free sit-down meal on Main Street.
prepOrOrderInstructions: At the pasta station, ask for plain un-sauced penne pasta (available on both the adult and kids' station) topped only with grated Parmesan and a warm breadstick.
watchOuts: Skip both the acidic marinara sauce and the heavy garlic pesto cream sauce during flares
